# Overview

This package fits Bayesian generalized models using MCMC.

# Methodological details

Full details are available in the paper:

[Full methodology](DLN-UTME_Model.pdf)

# Example

```r
library(BGM)

y <- floor(exp(rlnorm(100)))

fit <- UTME(y=y)
```
